posts.cooked:
Just got the Rook city and Infernal relics expansions (gleefully grinning from ear to ear) and I had at least one question.

 

With the Matriarch, all of her fowls say that after they are played play the top card of her deck. If that card is also a fowl then you rinse and repeat until you do not draw a fowl correct? I'm pretty sure I know the answer but I want to confirm. Also if she has the mask out then the first time she doesn't play a fowl she can play the top card of the villian deck, possibly starting the whole chain reaction again. This makes it completely possible, especially with my bad shuffling skills, for her to get every single fowl card out on the first turn.

 

I might use this thread to ask other questions as they come up, but that was the first one I had from just looking through all the decks
